name: Moncler
description: Moncler is synonymous with quality outerwear. Today, Moncler combines technical expertise and quality with style to produce clothes that are as much suited to the mountains as the city.

name: Monica Vinader
description: Monica Vinader is a British jewellery brand that celebrates individuality through a diverse range of contemporary pieces that can be stacked, styled and personalised for a completely customisable look.

name: Montblanc
description: The brand's uncompromising principles of design, style, quality and workmanship have allowed it to create heirloom collections that are passed from generation to generation.

name: Alexander McQueen
description: Alexander McQueen shows are known for their emotional power and raw energy, as well as the romantic but determinedly contemporary nature of the collections. Integral to the McQueen culture is the juxtaposition between contrasting elements: fragility and strength, tradition and modernity, fluidity and severity.

name: Mulberry
description: Mulberry is an iconic British fashion brand with design studios in London led by Creative Director Johnny Coca. It has a strong heritage in leather goods and creates stylish, functional products for modern lives.

name: AllSaints
description: AllSaints is a global, digital, contemporary brand with an independent spirit. Headquartered in East London, the company designs full collections of womenswear, menswear and accessories.

name: N.Peal
description: Since N.Peal was established in 1936, the brand has traded in luxurious cashmere knitwear from the exclusive Burlington Arcade in Mayfair, London. Many famous figures have worn N.Peal.

name: Orlebar Brown
description: Orlebar Brown launched in March 2007 as a more tailored approach to men's beach and swim shorts.

name: Annoushka
description:
Annoushka was founded in 2009 by entrepreneur and designer Annoushka Ducas and has gained popularity worldwide, with boutiques in Chelsea, Mayfair and at the Mandarin Oriental Hong Kong as well as concessions in some of the world's most famous department stores including Harrods, Harvey Nichols and Selfridges.
At the heart of the brand's designs is a love of storytelling and the designer's signature sense of fun: her 18 ct gold jewellery collections have a rich narrative inspired by her Russian heritage, her love of travelling and passion for colour. Working closely with her design team, Annoushka ensures the superlative craftsmanship and spirit of modernity defines every piece she conceives. "My design philosophy is very personal", Annoushka explains. "I create what I like to wear. It must be comfortable, versatile, unfussy, yet also tell a story."

name: Aquazzura
description: The Italian luxury footwear brand AQUAZZURA, founded in 2011 by Colombian designer Edgardo Osorio, is known for its sophisticated and playful design with uncompromising comfort. Striking the perfect balance between modern designs and impeccable craftsmanship, AQUAZZURA's elegant, timeless styles are crafted in Florence with attention to detail and a focus on wearability.

name: Pandora
description: Pandora invites you to celebrate life's unforgettable moments with its collection of stunning sterling silver and 14ct gold jewellery.

name: BOSS (Hugo Boss)
description:
BOSS offers sophisticated, modern collections focused on quality and design to create an impeccable look - be it business, casual or athleisure.
  
BOSS Menswear
BOSS Menswear has reached icon status for its tailoring, but offers more than the perfect suit. The collections also feature casual and athleisure pieces, presenting a complete wardrobe for fast-paced modern lifestyles. Tailoring and sportswear are brought together in a look that is ready for whatever the day may hold.
 
BOSS Womenswear
BOSS Womenswear touches all bases for modern-day living, from business and casual attire to eveningwear, with an emphasis on beautifully tailored pieces. Timeless styles with a fresh, modernist twist are an essential part of the collection, as are luxe leisure pieces. These two sides of the BOSS woman often meet in looks that combine tailoring with a casual ease.

name: Ba&sh
description:
A shared love for fashion led best friends Barbara Boccara & Sharon Krief to create ba&sh. Their idea? To bring their dream wardrobe to life so that they could share it with other women. A brand truly made by women for women
Found in more than 400 stores around the world, the ba&sh style remains distinctly Parisian, uniting an expression of freedom with an easy, joyful elegance. It is easy to recognize a ba&sh dress... The key? The happiness of the woman wearing it.

name: Balenciaga
description: Balenciaga is a French fashion house founded by Spanish designer Cristóbal Balenciaga. With a reputation as a couturier of uncompromising standards, he was referred to as "the master of us all" by Christian Dior.

name: Paul Smith
description: Paul Smith is Britain's foremost designer. He is known for his creative aesthetic that combines tradition and modernity.

name: Penhaligon's
description: Penhaligon's is a British perfumer, founded in 1870 by William Penhaligon. Characterised by our longstanding relationship with royalty, as proud holders of two Royal Warrants from HRH the Duke of Edinburgh and HRH the Prince of Wales, as well as our creativity and rich heritage of 145 years.

name: Bamford
description: With its beautiful clothing, body and skincare items that are both natural and handmade, Bamford is a philosophy rather than a seasonal fashion label.

name: Barbour
description: The Barbour story began in 1894 in South Shields in the North East of England. Founder John Barbour began supplying garments to protect the growing community of sailors, fishermen and dockers. These first weatherproof items quickly established Barbour's reputation for innovation and quality.

name: Ralph Lauren Children
description: On Sundays the boutique opens at 11.30 for browsing, 12.00 for shopping and close by 18.00.

name: Ralph Lauren
description: On Sundays the boutique opens at 11.30 for browsing, 12.00 for shopping and close by 18.00. Closed on Easter Sunday.

name: Bicester Village Rail Station & Arrivals Lounge
Prada
description:
Producing luxury lifestyle products since 1913, Prada prides itself on uncompromised quality and design innovation.
Focusing on rare and valuable materials that are long lasting and durable, Prada encapsulates sophisticated manufacturing techniques. Prada has become a well-known household name, loved by customers from across the globe.
Visit the Prada store at Bicester Village and discover ready-to-wear handbags, purses, footwear, accessories, eyewear, fragrances and leather goods.
On Sundays the boutique opens at 11.30 for browsing, 12.00 for shopping and close by 18.00.

name: Pret a Manger
description: The delicious fare on offer at this popular gourmet sandwich stop includes fresh soup, filled baguettes, spicy melts, crispy salads and deluxe sushi. Pret is passionate about food and where its ingredients come from, and the menu is constantly updated so there is always something new to try.

name: Bonpoint
description: Drawing on the expertise and savoir faire of its atelier in Paris, Bonpoint is a couture house for children that beautifully cultivates the precision of beauty, the passion for quality and a meticulous attention to detail and finish.

name: Bottega Veneta
description: Discretion, quality, and craftsmanship - Bottega Veneta has created a new standard of luxury since its founding in Vicenza in 1966. Steeped in the traditions of Italy's master leather craftsmen and long celebrated for its extraordinary leather goods, Bottega Veneta has emerged as one of the world's premier luxury brands.

name: Reiss
description: Since its creation by David Reiss in 1971, Reiss has established a design philosophy centred on creating design-led menswear, womenswear and accessories.

name: Brioni
description: Founded in Rome in 1945, Brioni is recognised as one of the world's most prestigious menswear couture houses. Throughout its 70-year history, the brand has become synonymous with excellence and quality, taking pride in its bespoke garments, sartorial ready-to-wear collections, artisanal bags, footwear and accessories, all crafted in Italy.

name: Rituals
description: Inspired by the wisdom and ancient traditions of Asian cultures, Rituals created an extensive collection of luxurious yet affordable products for home and body. Rituals products are designed to help you slow down, to find happiness in the smallest of things. It is their passion to transform everyday routines into more meaningful rituals.

name: Brunello Cucinelli
description: Brunello Cucinelli, founded in 1978 by the eponymous stylist and entrepreneur, is an Italian fashion house specialising in luxury cashmere. Brunello Cucinelli's success is rooted in the history and legacy of great craftsmanship as well as in modern design. A symbol of Italian lifestyle worldwide, Brunello Cucinelli is based in the medieval hamlet of Solomeo, on the outskirts of Perugia. Distributed internationally in more than 60 countries worldwide, the brand continues to convey both creativity and craftsmanship through its innovative collections.

name: Burberry
description: Burberry is a luxury British fashion brand, established in 1856. Today, the Burberry name is globally synonymous with design innovation, craftsmanship and a uniquely British sensibility.

name: CH Carolina Herrera
description: The chic and elegance of Carolina Herrera are reflected in her lifestyle label CH Carolina Herrera. A whole universe that incorporates clothes for women, men, children and a complete accessories collection. The quality and the distinct sign of her designs merge into her stores, beautiful spaces full of elegance, personality and style.

name: Roger Vivier
description: Roger Vivier made the buckle his signature with the 'Belle Vivier' ballerinas and pumps, coveted by women all over the world, including style icons such as Brigitte Bardot, Marlene Dietrich and even Queen Elizabeth II.

name: Saint Laurent
description: Founded in 1961, Yves Saint Laurent was the first couture house to introduce, in 1966, the concept of luxury prêt-à-porter with a collection called "Saint Laurent Rive Gauche", synonymous with youth and freedom. This shift represented a first critical step in the modernization of fashion and revolutionized the socio-cultural landscape.

name: Ferragamo
description: Salvatore Ferragamo moved to America from Italy in 1914, eventually ending up in Hollywood where his repair and shoe-making business began to attract attention.

name: Calvin Klein
description: Youthful, seductive and cool, Calvin Klein Jeans is the casual expression of a modern American designer's lifestyle. It's rooted in denim and is famous for its unique details and innovative designs. Each season at the Calvin Klein boutique the brand embraces its American legacy.

name: Samsonite
description: Whether travelling for business or leisure, city breaks or long haul, holidays or day-to-day, Samsonite has the perfect bag for every occasion.

name: Sandro
description: Behind the Sandro brand is the story of a family's adventure. Sandro is Evelyne Chetrite, who came into fashion at a young age, visiting her grandfather's shirt store and being fascinated by her aunt - a seamstress - who dressed her in made-to-measure clothes.

name: Charles Tyrwhitt
description: Charles Tyrwhitt (pronounced 'Tirrit') produces the finest menswear with timeless style and without compromising on quality, coupled with exemplary customer service, attractive prices and a pinch of British charm thrown in for good measure. To ensure the perfect fit, the staff at Charles Tyrwhitt will be on hand to help measure you up and introduce you to your perfect tailoring.

name: Shan Shui
description:
Shan Shui pays homage to the best of Asian cuisine. Inspired by 1920s Shanghai, the restaurant's décor features a myriad of textures, colours and textiles, which is a nod to city's most glamorous era. The kitchen follows time-honoured recipes and works only with the freshest ingredients sourced locally.
The menu features a selection of Chinese culinary wonders along with popular South-East Asian favourites. It also boasts a range of bite-sized Dim Sum that are steamed fresh daily. Our dumplings and bao buns are presented in piping hot bamboo steamer baskets and are perfect for sharing.

name: Chloé
description: French fashion house, Chloé was founded in 1952 by Gaby Aghion, an Egyptian-born Parisienne with a bohemian spirit. Rejecting the stiff formality of 1950s haute couture, she created soft, alluring clothes from the finest fabrics. The brand is both independent and bold, with an acute sense of beauty. Today, Natacha Ramsay-Levi is Chloé's Creative Director, bringing her unique vision to the forefront and embodying an elegant femininity with her designs.

name: Stella McCartney
description: Effortlessly sexy, with a modern edge, Stella McCartney collections inspire a natural confidence and cool attitude.

name: Coach
description:
Coach is a modern American luxury brand with a rich heritage rooted in quality and craftsmanship. All over the world, the Coach name is synonymous with the ease and sophistication of New York style.
 On Sundays the boutique opens at 11.30 for browsing, 12.00 for shopping and close by 18.00.

name: Swarovski
description: Swarovski was founded in 1895 by Daniel Swarovski, a bohemian inventor and visionary, who moved to the village of Wattens, Austria, with his newly invented machine for cutting and polishing crystal stones.

name: Crêperie Angélie
description: Crêperie Angélie at Bicester Village has become an icon for delicious traditional crêpes with a modern twist. Using artisan techniques that stretch back generations, Crêperie Angélie is all about fresh & natural ingredients, small producers and keeping it local wherever possible. Every crepe is lovingly hand-made to order using the finest Cotswold-milled organic flour and local farm free range eggs and filled with your choice of delicious sweet or savoury ingredients.

name: TAG Heuer
description: TAG Heuer: the Swiss Avant-Garde watchmaker since 1860. Its rich heritage is built on pushing boundaries and breaking rules: harnessing mental fortitude to overcome technology restraints and create daring watches and chronographs.

name: DIESEL
description: Diesel is never just a pair of jeans. It's a statement on individuality and self-expression, a battle cry for innovation, artistry and technical expertise, and a belief that passion is the greatest muse.

name: The Cosmetics Company Store
description: Discover the following brands inside The Cosmetics Company Store: Estee Lauder, Crème De La Mer, Clinique, Origins, Darphin, Glamglow, Aveda, Bumble & Bumble, Lab Series, Aramis, Jo Malone, Dr Jart+, Bobbi Brown, Too Faced, Smashbox, MAC. Tom Ford, By Kilian, Frederic Malle.

name: The North Face®
description: The North Face® was founded in 1966 with the goal of preparing outdoor athletes for the rigors of their next adventure. Today it is one of the world's leading outdoor brands, creating athlete-tested, expedition-proven items that help people explore and test the limits of human potential.

name: Dior
description:
Dior still conveys the essence of Hollywood glamour today. Dior has always been a favourite of Hollywood stars with the likes of Jennifer Lawrence, Charlize Theron and Natalie Portman in the front row at Dior shows. Dior Homme is the menswear division of Christian Dior, the Dior Homme style has won recognition by adapting its proportions to the contemporary man’s body. The streamlined silhouette is sober, elegant and refined.

On Sundays the boutique opens at 11.30 for browsing, 12.00 for shopping and close by 18.00.

name: The White Company
description: One of the UK's fastest-growing multichannel retailers, The White Company has been specialising in beautifully designed, impeccably stylish products, principally in white, for more than 20 years.

name: Timberland
description: Initially a footwear manufacturer, the brand name Timberland was introduced in 1973 for boots produced using new moulding technology that eliminated the need for stitching.

name: Dolce & Gabbana
description:
Based on sartorial strength and creativity, Dolce & Gabbana is authentic, unconventional and expressive. The strong identity of the brand has evolved over the years without ever forgetting its roots. It has come to represent a new form of elegance which, season after season, combines strong innovation with Mediterranean flavour, a brand whose essence lies in its contrasting features.
On Sundays the boutique opens at 11.30 for browsing, 12.00 for shopping and close by 18.00.

name: Tod's
description:
Refined, luxurious Italian quality is brought to life in the Tod's collection of hand-crafted 'Made in Italy' leather goods. Synonymous for its understated luxury and desirable quality, Tod's is a timeless brand for those with immaculate taste, offering products that will last a lifetime.
For the past three generations, Tod's has been producing high-quality products including durable yet stylish footwear and functional yet fashionable handbags. Tod's signature designs include the classic D-bags and Gommini, much loved and desired by lovers of iconic looks.
On Sundays the boutique opens at 11.30 for browsing, 12.00 for shopping and close by 18.00.

name: Emma Bridgewater
description:
Emma Bridgewater is best known for its hand-decorated pottery, made at the company's factory in Stoke-on-Trent, England. We believe everyday kitchen china sits right at the heart of our lives, and that each cup, bowl, jug, and plate holds our personal stories, reflecting shared moments, enriching us as we eat and drink together.
Emma Bridgewater patterns also appear on a growing range of home and lifestyle products including bedding, home fragrance, enamel, fabrics, radios, glass and stationery.

name: Zegna
description: Ermenegildo Zegna is an icon of Italian craftsmanship, combining world-leading fabrics with visionary design. Led by Artistic Director Alessandro Sartori, and sourcing fabric from its family-owned factories in Northern Italy, Zegna offers over a century of sartorial legacy with a bold sense of innovation. With subtle patterns, luxurious tailoring, and iconic fabrics, Ermenegildo Zegna is the world leader in contemporary luxury menswear.

name: Tommy Hilfiger
description: The Tommy Hilfiger boutique showcases a wide selection of the brand's collections, including men's and women's sportswear, men's denim, and footwear and accessories.

name: Fendi
description: The house of Fendi was established by Adele and Edoardo Fendi in Rome in 1925. The opening of the first Fendi boutique, followed by a handbag shop and fur workshop, soon won the brand international acclaim, Fendi emerged as a name renowned for its elegance, craftsmanship, innovation and style. Today Fendi is synonymous with quality, tradition, experimentation and creativity.

name: Tory Burch
description: Tory Burch is an American lifestyle brand that embodies the personal style and sensibility of its CEO and designer, Tory Burch. Launched in February 2004, the collection, known for color, print and eclectic details, includes ready-to-wear, shoes, handbags, accessories, and fragrance and beauty.

name: UGG®
description:
Founded in 1978 on the coast of California by an Australian surfer, UGG® is a global lifestyle brand renowned for its iconic Classic boot.
First worn by Hollywood royalty, fashion editors, and then the world, UGG® has since expanded beyond the icon to design footwear, apparel, accessories, and home decor with an uncompromising attitude toward creativity, quality and craftsmanship.

name: Gina
description: Gina was established in 1954 in London by master shoemaker Mehmet Kurdash. He had a dream to make glamorous, handmade shoes and named the company after his muse, movie icon Gina Lollobrigida.

name: Under Armour
description: Under Armour's mission is to make all athletes better through passion, design and the relentless pursuit of innovation. Under Armour is the originator of performance apparel - gear engineered to keep athletes cool and dry throughout the course of a game, practice or workout.

name: Givenchy
description: Givenchy, founded in 1952 by Hubert de Givenchy, is an international luxury house known for its haute couture, ready-to-wear and accessories' collections for men and women. Since spring 2017, Clare Waight Keller has been the Artistic Director of the Maison. With her debut show, she established a forward-looking new signature for the House based on the idea of Light in darkness.

name: Valentino
description:
The story began in 1959. 2016 marks a new beginning, under the Creative Direction of Pierpaolo Piccioli. A new set of values, that are both of the moment and faithful to its heritage, are created: grace and delicacy, both as an attitude and as a silhouette; a celebration of individuality; emotional beauty; the blending and merging of different languages.

Style is essential and impalpable.

name: Golden Goose Deluxe Brand
description: Golden Goose Deluxe Brand was founded in 2000 by two young Venetian creatives who, with passion and dedication, started what quickly became one of the most successful independent Italian brands of the last decade. The unique brand is founded on the search for 'vivere' - the pleasure of living - and goes one step further than fashion. Its team mentality encompasses a desire for artisanal perfection, community building, artistic engagement and family values. In less than ten years the company has managed to create a brand that provides its customers with a complete look, with a collection including shirts, outerwear, leather goods, accessories and, of course, its line of trainers, the brand's bestselling piece.

name: Versace
description: Founded in 1978, Versace is one of the leading global fashion design houses. Under the artistic direction of Donatella Versace since 1997, Versace designs, manufactures, distributes and retails fashion and lifestyle products including haute couture, women's and men's ready-to-wear, jewellery, watches, accessories, fragrances and furniture.

name: Gucci
description:
Influential, innovative and progressive, Gucci is reinventing a wholly modern approach to fashion. The House has redefined luxury for the 21st century, further reinforcing its position as one of the world's most desirable fashion houses. Eclectic, contemporary, romantic — Gucci products represent the pinnacle of Italian craftsmanship and are unsurpassed for their quality and attention to detail.
 
On Sundays the boutique opens at 11.30 for browsing, 12.00 for shopping and closes by 18.00.

name: Vilebrequin
description: Vilebrequin has always cultivated a spirit of refinement and fantasy, staying true to the casual charm upon which the house was founded in Saint-Tropez more than 40 years ago. Durable and always in fashion, Vilebrequin swimsuits have become a point of reference for generations of fathers and sons. Now, Vilebrequin is further expanding its role as ambassador for the art of living around the beach with a women's line that includes swimwear, ready-to-wear and accessories - and, as always, focused on making summer last all year long.

name: Villeroy & Boch
description: Villeroy & Boch’s portfolio encompasses everything required to create a beautiful home: high-quality living-accessories in addition to tableware, cutlery and glasses for a stylish table setting.

name: Hackett London
description: The home of British menswear, Hackett's collections are built around impeccable tailoring, complemented by luxurious casual wear. From their origins in London's fashionable Chelsea, Hackett has a history of always providing the best for the most discerning of men and Hackett stores offer a wide range of products and services to cater for all of a man's sartorial needs.

name: Vivienne Westwood
description: With a design record spanning more than 40 years, Vivienne Westwood is one of the last independent global fashion companies in the world. At times thought-provoking, each collection brings a fresh set of ideas that raise awareness of both environmental and human rights issues.

name: Holland Cooper
description:
Established by designer Jade Holland Cooper in 2008, Holland Cooper is a luxury lifestyle brand that effortlessly bridges the gap between town and country, with a refined aesthetic and commitment to quality materials.
A champion of British manufacturing, Holland Cooper is renowned for practical, yet stylish tweed for men and women, and is one of the country's leading buyers of British wool and tweed. Today, the brand has evolved to offer a comprehensive range of luxury clothing and accessories reflective of the Holland Cooper customer. With British innovation and industry at its heart, the business continues to flourish as one of the UK's most exciting, young fashion labels whilst remaining true to its original vision and values.

name: Hour Passion
description:
Hour Passion is a specialist watch boutique, offering some of the most exciting and globally revered Swiss Made brands of the Swatch Group that includes LONGINES, RADO, TISSOT, CERTINA, BALMAIN, MIDO, HAMILTON, CALVIN KLEIN WATCHES + JEWELRY and SWATCH .
Hour Passion prominently houses each brand in its own individual retail space, allowing you a closer look at the brands' unique features. Make time for Hour Passion and marvel at your next extraordinary timepiece.

name: ZWILLING
description: The distinctive Zwilling logo has become an emblem of a sophisticated lifestyle, with a company heritage dating back more than 280 years. Known for high-quality kitchen products, cutlery and beauty instruments, Zwilling's unique success story is thanks to innovative products that consistently set benchmarks

name: Jimmy Choo
description: Founded in London in 1996, Jimmy Choo is an iconic luxury fashion brand defined by an empowered sense of glamour and a confident sense of style. A pioneer in the art of celebrity dressing, Jimmy Choo was among the first to bring shoes and handbags to Hollywood.

name: dunhill
description: Dunhill London is design-driven with style, substance and purpose, engineering unique and stylish luxuries for men.

name: KENZO
description: With its abundant prints, vibrant color combinations and cultural influences from all over the world, Kenzo offers a luxuriant and versatile world where spontaneity takes control.

name: Itsu
description: The early pioneers of Pret are the creative force behind itsu. Its 'eat beautiful' menu celebrates the amazing flavours of the Far East - high in nutrients yet refreshingly low in calories and saturated fat. Protein-packed low-carb salads, fields of crunchy vegetables, delicious hot chicken noodle soups, brown rice pots, freshly made sushi and sashimi as well as frozen yoghurt and beauty smoothies too. 64 delicious dishes all freshly prepared in each itsu every day.

name: kate spade new york
description: Crisp colour, graphic prints and playful sophistication are all hallmarks of kate spade new york.

name: L'Occitane en Provence
description: L'Occitane captures the essence of Provence in sensorial bath, body, skincare and fine fragrance products formulated with the finest natural ingredients. A unique brand that is loved across the world, L'Occitane takes its inspiration from the captivating colours, scents and traditions of Provence. With award-winning products such as the Shea Butter hand cream and authentic scents typical of the south of France such as lavender, rose and cherry blossom, each L'Occitane product tells a true story about the men and women who live and work in these regions, preserving traditions and age-old customs.

name: Lacoste
description: Lacoste is a lifestyle brand, born of the inventiveness of a tennis champion, René Lacoste, who created the first polo shirt ever, initially for himself and for his friends, to be both relaxed and elegant on and off the tennis courts.

name: Lalique
description: Lalique is known globally as one the leading companies in the crystal, jewellery and perfume world, renowned for its unique expertise in the manufacture of crystal. Founded by René Lalique in the early twentieth century, the company specialises in the creation and production of luxury pieces for the home and jewellery. Every collection is harmoniously crafted with refinement and skill, and is the ultimate representation of artisanal skills, the utmost precision and the fundamental values of Lalique: luxury, excellence and creativity.

name: Le Creuset
description: Le Creuset began producing its first enamelled cast iron pots in 1925 from its foundry in Fresnoy le Grand, France. Using hand-crafted techniques and the original process of forging and casting for almost 100 years, innovation is key to the brand's success.

name: Levi's®
description: The Levi's® brand epitomises classic American style and effortless cool. Since their invention by Levi Strauss & Co, in 1873, Levi's® jeans have become one of the most recognisable garments of clothing in the world - capturing the imagination and loyalty of people for generations.

name: The Double Red Duke
description: Cosy up by the fire and make the most of The Double Red Duke’s quintessential British menu, featuring flame-grilled favourites. Tuck into a mouth-watering roast dinner, classic English breakfast and perfect puddings.

name: Loewe
description: LOEWE is one of the world's major luxury brands. With more than 170 years of history, it is defined by the modernity of its past, an unwavering confidence in the present, and a firm look forward.

name: Longchamp
description: French luxury house Longchamp was founded in Paris in 1948 by Jean Cassegrain, and is still owned and run by the Cassegrain family today. Longchamp's handbags, luggage and accessories have a worldwide reputation for craftsmanship and quality, which now extends to shoes and ready-to-wear collections. Longchamp is an international brand that has maintained momentum and energy across the decades.

name: Loro Piana
description: Founded in 1924, Loro Piana is one of the world's leading manufacturers of fine fabrics, later adding luxurious clothing and quality accessories to its offering.

name: lululemon
description: Whether you’re training, practicing yoga, outside or at the gym, lululemon is there for you. Founded in Vancouver, Canada, the brand was born from a love of daily sweat, the desire to innovate technical gear and the appetite to build a community where everyone can live their best life.

name: Maje
description: Fascinated by fabrics from an early age, designer Judith Milgrom founded Maje in 1998 after a childhood spent crafting garments, and named the label using the initials of her closest loved ones.

name: Max Mara
description: Max Mara has been a leading Italian ready-to-wear brand since 1951.

name: Michael Kors
description:
Michael Kors is a world-renowned designer of luxury accessories and ready-to-wear and footwear offering a lifestyle for the consummate jet-setter that is as sophisticated as it is indulgent and as glamorous as it is modern.
On Sundays the boutique opens at 11.30 for browsing, 12.00 for shopping and close by 18.00.

name: Missoni
description: With its playful energy, vibrant aesthetic and innovative spirit, Missoni has changed the very identity of knitwear forever. The art-inspired prints and sensual textures broke new ground, propelling Missoni to the forefront of Italian luxury.

name: Molton Brown
description: Molton Brown has long been synonymous with luxury and indulgence. Inspired by exotic locations, each of its products is bursting with fragrant essential oils and plant extracts to nourish the skin and stimulate the senses.

name: HUGO
description: Offering a range of tailoring and casual pieces including the special HUGO Logo Collection, which has become a favourite amongst the Instagram community for its selfie ready design.

name: North Train Station Shuttle pick up/drop off
Clarins
description: A trusted and respected family business that strives to reveal the natural beauty of women across the globe, Clarins is defined by its unique expertise in plant-based skincare and make-up created without compromise.

name: Breitling
description: An authentic brand for men and women of style, purpose and action. Since 1884, Breitling has established a reputation for high-precision timepieces and design excellence. Renowned for its spirit of innovation, it has earned a place of privilege in the worlds of aviation, science, sport, and technology. Breitling manufactures its own movements in-house and the quality of every watch is confirmed by its status as a COSC-certified chronometer, made in Switzerland.

name: Balmain
description:
Founded by Pierre Balmain in 1945, the brand is quintessentially Parisian in flair.

Its collections, which feature richly embroidered fabrics and nipped-in waists, are characterised by Balmain’s signature silhouette of the jolie madame – or ‘pretty lady’. While the house famously remains true to the trailblazing vision of its founder, today Creative Director Olivier Rousteing’s couture spirit – seen in his careful attention to detail – is balanced by the collections’ modernity.

name: Manolo Blahnik
description: With a career spanning nearly 50 years, Manolo Blahnik is one of the world's most influential footwear designers. His eponymous footwear brand has spellbound a set of adoring and loyal devotees across the globe.

name: Thom Browne
description: Thom Browne is widely recognized for challenging and modernizing today’s uniform: the suit. By questioning traditional proportions, Browne’s designs consistently convey a true American sensibility rooted in quality craftsmanship and precise tailoring.

name: Sweaty Betty
description:
Multi-sport activewear designed to empower women through fitness and beyond.

Founded in Notting Hill, London, Sweaty Betty creates premium performance apparel for active women. Famous for bum-sculpting leggings and sports luxe styles, each piece is designed by women for women to perform for multiple sports, from yoga, to running, swim to snow.

name: EV Electric Vehicle Charging Points North
EV Electric Vehicle Charging Points West
Etro
description: ETRO was founded in 1968 when visionary Gimmo Etro launched an exclusive production of highly prestigious fabrics. Since then, the ETRO family business has developed into a true Italian lifestyle: men’s and women’s prêt-à-porter collections, accessories, home furnishings and fragrances all share the brand's unique style recognizable for its free-spirited attitude and eclectic iconic prints.

name: Christian Louboutin
description:
Internationally renowned for his iconic red soles, Christian Louboutin celebrates empowerment & diversity with his eclectic and playful designs.

Christian Louboutin is one of the world’s most well-known shoe-designers. He established his business in the heart of Paris in 1991, first with a collection for Women’s shoes followed a few years later by one for Men, both recognizable by the signature red lacquered sole. His designs share a luxurious aesthetic of playfulness, Parisian chic and unique craftmanship. With a prolific collection of women’s and men’s shoes, handbags and small leather goods, Christian Louboutin celebrates empowerment and diversity.

name: Hogan at Tod's
description:
Sophisticated accessories and clothing, with an essential, innovative design and the perfect combination of function and informal elegance, made in top-quality materials.

Find Hogan inside the Tod's boutique.

name: Bang & Olufsen
description: Bang & Olufsen is a luxury audio brand founded in 1925 in Denmark, by Peter Bang and Svend Olufsen. With a rich heritage and a relentless determination to innovate beyond the imagination, today every Bang & Olufsen product is still characterised by a unique combination of beautiful sound, timeless design and unrivalled craftsmanship.

description: Discover Shiseido within the Beauté Prestige International boutique.

name: JIL SANDER
description: JIL SANDER, the high-end luxury brand, is the epitome of modernity and sophistication. Its unconditional dedication to contemporary design combines elegance and purity with innovative materials and exceptional craftsmanship.

name: Benefit Cosmetics
description: Discover feel-good beauty with Benefit Cosmetics’ fun and innovative skincare and make-up collections, designed to put a smile on your face.

name: Tommy Hilfiger Women's & Kid's
description:
TOMMY HILFIGER is one of the world’s leading premium designer lifestyle brands.
 
TOMMY HILFIGER is globally recognized for celebrating the essence of classic American cool style with a twist. Founded in 1985, Tommy Hilfiger delivers premium styling, quality and value to consumers worldwide under the TOMMY HILFIGER and TOMMY JEANS brands, with collections including HILFIGER COLLECTION, women’s and kids’ sportswear, accessories, and footwear

name: Isabel Marant
description: Say Isabel Marant, think Parisian flow. Having founded her label in ’94, she instantly became renowned for her pioneering and cosmopolitan spirit bringing self-affirmation and feel good effect to her dégaine.

name: La Tua Pasta
description: La Tua Pasta is a multi-award-winning artisan Pastificio that makes their fresh pasta nightly in the outskirts of London, before being delivered to your plate just in time for lunch!

name: ELEMIS
description: With over 30 years of British skin wellness innovation, ELEMIS believe in Truth in Beauty; Pro-skincare powered by active naturals in sublime textures with proven results.

name: Moose Knuckles
description: Moose Knuckles, based in Montreal, Canada, is one of the world's leading producers of luxury outerwear, sportswear and accessories. The brand was founded by Canadians whose family heritage traces back over 100 years in the parka business.

name: Eleventy
description: Eleventy is the Made in Italy brand, founded in Milan with the dream of delivering a message of Smart Luxury.

name: Ladurée
description: It all began in 1862, when Louis Ernest Ladurée, a miller from France’s southwest, created a bakery in Paris at 16 rue Royale. The beginning of this century found Paris wrapped up in a frenzy of distraction and going out in public.

name: Oliphant's
description: Oliphant & Pomeroy return with their Great Taste award-winning cinnamon buns, chocolate buns and their nutty Pecan Buns freshly baked throughout the day and served warm.

name: Maison Margiela
description: Maison Margiela is a Parisian haute couture house founded on ideas of nonconformity and the subversion of norms. Under the creative direction of John Galliano, collectively shared dress codes are inverted and redefined in an analytical wardrobe proposal for the digital age. Driven by instinct, the Maison is devoted to uncompromising creativity invigorated by values of authenticity, radicality and self-expression.

name: Ralph's Coffee
description: Ralph's Coffee, the global coffee concept from iconic designer and coffee devotee Ralph Lauren is now available at Bicester Village. Stationed in Ralph's Coffee's hunter green 1965 Citroen.

name: David Clulow Sunglasses
description: David Clulow Sunglasses stocks the finest luxury fashion brands including Michael Kors, Ray-Ban, Prada, Dolce & Gabbana, Tiffany, Bvlgari, Versace, Ralph Lauren, Giorgio Armani, Persol, Burberry and Oakley, to name a few. With so many beautiful frames to choose from, you’ll be spoilt for choice.

name: Tumi
description: Exceptional quality and high-performance products have made TUMI the leading International, lifestyle and accessories brand that travelers depend on consistently.

name: Cecconi's
description: Cecconi’s Bicester Village will be offering a hybrid northern Italian menu including oven baked pizzas alongside a luxury dining experience for guests in the heart of Oxfordshire.

name: NEOM Organics
description: Whether you need better sleep, less stress, more energy or a mood boost, each and every NEOM product harnesses the power of pure essential oils to make a difference to your wellbeing, whilst also smelling incredible thanks to our 100% natural fragrances.

name: Watchfinder & Co.
description: Founded in 2002, Watchfinder & Co. is the premier resource for buying, selling and exchanging pre-owned luxury watches.

name: Axel Arigato
description: Axel Arigato was launched with one main objective: to embrace the now and always look for the tomorrow. Known for its breakdown and shattering of the traditional seasonal calendar, through its unique system of weekly drops.

name: Charlotte Tilbury
description:
Get ready to make your beauty dreams come true at the Charlotte Tilbury Beauty Wonderland, now open at Bicester Village! 

Loved by supermodels, stars and beauty experts, Charlotte’s award-winning collection of makeup, fragrance and skincare secrets bottle 30+ years of artistry and expertise – so everyone, everywhere can look and feel like the most beautiful, confident version of themselves!

name: Stone Island
description: Founded in 1982, Stone Island is the symbol of extreme research in fibres and textiles, applied to an innovative design. The Italian man sportswear brand developed an unique capacity to work on the finished garment, via continuous experimentation with dyes and treatments.

name: GANNI
description:
On a journey to become the most responsible version of itself, GANNI is now a B Corp certified company and publishes an annual Responsibility Report to publicly share its progress – committing to a 50% absolute carbon reduction by 2027.

As part of the brand’s ongoing commitment to certified and innovative fabrics, GANNI has promised to create 100% of their collections from certified recycled, organic, or lower-impact fabrics in the future.

name: Lindt
description:
Welcome to our newest home where guests can curate luxury hampers, nostalgically self-serve from over one trillion pick and mix flavour combinations or explore our luxury assorted gift boxes. 

Whether it be to gift the chocolate lover in your life or simply an expression of self-love, Lindt have the perfect treat.

name: Astrid & Miyu
description:
Known for being a purpose driven brand, A&M was set up in 2012 by Founder and CEO Connie Nam from her flat in Notting Hill after she struggled to find contemporary jewellery at affordable prices with a mission to revolutionise how we experience jewellery.

Visit their additional new boutique, next to Swarovski in the Village to discover its new jewellery service – available for a limited time only.

name: Bremont
description: Bremont is a British luxury watch brand manufacturing mechanical watches in Henley-on-Thames, England.

name: Marc Jacobs
description: Founded in New York City in 1984, Marc Jacobs embraces authenticity and self-expression. With Ready-to-Wear, footwear, handbags and accessories directly inspired by our Runway collections, the brand is an ongoing celebration of the high and the low, the everyday and the extraordinary.

name: Ottolenghi
description: We are excited to announce Ottolenghi is now open at Bicester Village. Big salad platters, iconic cakes and all the lemons, za'atar and aubergines will feature in their newest location.

name: On Running
description:
On was born in the Swiss Alps with one goal: to revolutionise the sensation of running by empowering all to run on clouds.
14 years later On delivers industry-disrupting innovation in premium footwear, apparel, and accessories for high- performance running, outdoor, and all-day activities. Fuelled by customer- recommendation, On’s award-winning CloudTec® innovation, purposeful design and groundbreaking strides in sportswear’s circular economy have attracted a fast- growing global fanbase — inspiring humans to explore, discover and dream on.

name: Ami Paris
description: Born in Paris in 2011, inspired by Paris ever since - AMI offers stylish and comprehensive wardrobes for men and women, blurring the boundaries between casual and chic.

name: New Balance New
description: For generations, New Balance has created innovative footwear, apparel and accessories that elevate the performance of athletes.

name: Humble Crumble
description: Britain’s most nostalgic dessert. It’s simple and sweet and at Humble Crumble we only make crumbles. We use high quality and sustainably sourced ingredients and we prepare and bake each crumble individually by hand on site.

name: miu miu
description: Miu Miu celebrates and empowers women – celebrates and empowers humanity. Youthful in spirit, today Miu Miu is free from gender binaries, its unifying trait is its strength, intelligence and individuality. Over the past thirty years, Miu Miu has been pivotal in the redefinition of fashion’s relationship with film, music, architecture, and art.

name: CELINE
description: Celine dresses women with fierce style, while encapsulating the elegance and femininity every woman desires for her wardrobe. Using noble materials to create precise silhouettes, Celine is the ultimate signature of Parisian style. Chic and classic, pieces from Celine are timeless investments that will add instant glamour and sophistication to capsule clothing collections.

name: Fortnum & Mason on the go.
description: Welcome to Fortnum & Mason – the home of extraordinary food, drink and joyful living since 1707.

name: Birkenstock
description: The Original BIRKENSTOCK Footbed is an ergonomic masterpiece, designed to replicate the mindful experience of walking barefoot. Shaped to follow the natural contours of the foot. For stability, arch support, and effortless motion with every step.

name: Acqua di Parma
description: Symbolic of Italian refinement, Acqua Di Parma offers elegant fragrances expertly produced by traditional craftspeople. Expect the iconic Colonia, a renowned scent that captures the essence of Mediterranean sunshine.

name: Guerlain
description: Guerlain is the Parisian alchemist that pursues an infinite quest for the wonder of senses and crafts artistic beauty from Nature, since 1828. As a House of High Perfumery and High Cosmetics, it elevated bespoke to the level of Art. This is what makes it exceptional.

name: Bear St Bakery
description: We reimagine timeless classics with uncompromising Swiss quality. By combining the world’s finest ingredients with expert craftsmanship, we transform simple childhood treats into extraordinary experiences. It’s a celebration of familiar flavors, made special.

name: CurrentBody
description: For over 15 years, we've pioneered the fastest-growing category in beauty, bringing key aesthetic technologies from the clinic into safe, effective at-home devices. Known worldwide for creating the first flexible LED light therapy mask, we’ve continued to shape the future of at-home beauty innovation. Through independent clinical testing and collaboration with leading doctors, dermatologists, aestheticians and university researchers, we prove the safety and efficacy of every product.

name: Alaïa
description: Founded in 1964, Alaïa, a Parisian fashion maison, has always stood apart. Azzedine Alaïa, guided by instinct and discipline, sculpted garments with exceptional savoir-faire, celebrating the female form with precision. Today, the House renews its design language through distinct innovation and craftsmanship, reinterpreting its codes while preserving its essential purity, driven by a singular vision of modern beauty and a passion for the arts.

name: Shreeji News Presents: The Village News
Vuori
description: Vuori is built to move and sweat in, yet designed with a west-coast aesthetic that transitions effortlessly into everyday life. Breaking down the boundaries of traditional activewear; a new perspective on performance apparel.
